description: Amendments to the Finance Act, No.35 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A levy has been imposed on Cellular Towers under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, and accordingly, an amount of Rs.200,000/- is levied annually from mobile phone operators who own cellular towers. However, the 2026 Budget has proposed not to charge the relevant levy until the expiry of a period of 05 years for newly constructed cellular towers on or after 2026-01-01. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared a Bill to amend the Finance Act No. 35 of 2018, including provisions for taking necessary steps, and the Attorney General has given his clearance for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
